tax.name: Indiana state sales tax plus county innkeeper's tax

note_add: Tax: rates exclude tax; Indiana state sales tax plus the county innkeeper's tax are added, so the total varies by county. The $6 transaction fee is charged on web and phone reservations, never on walk-in registrations in the field. Six people a site at most. One vehicle a site at most properties (very few allow two); extra vehicles park in overflow lots and each pays its own entrance fee. Weekend rates (Thursday-Saturday) run +$3 non-electric, +$7 electric, +$10 full hookup and +$0 primitive over Sunday-Wednesday, with a higher holiday-weekend column, so no single flat premium fits the row.

note_add: No park admission fee. Tax: 6% sales tax plus the 1% state transient tax are added to every camping fee, and county taxes on top, so the total varies by county (7% before county tax). Fri-Sat and holiday premiums vary by park and site type ($0-12 over Sun-Thu, holiday $0-10 more), so no flat premium fits the row.
